about.label: About Us
about.title: Surrounded by Nature, Steeped in History
about.text: Just a 10-minute walk from the ancient city of Olympos, a peaceful camping experience awaits you in the cool shade of an orange grove. Close to local markets, our site offers a fire pit, wooden platforms and a shared kitchen — letting you enjoy an unforgettable getaway in the heart of nature without sacrificing comfort.

items.title: Wooden Platforms
items.desc: A ready base for your tent

items.name: İlhan D.
items.text: The food was clean, tasty and filling. Showers and toilets were great for tent camping. The owner is friendly, knowledgeable about the area and very helpful. The site blends into nature, with tents shaded by trees. We had no safety concerns at all.

items.name: Orkun A.
items.text: Set in a spacious lemon grove, isolated from the road by a streambed - a calm, shaded campsite with generous spacing between tents. Hala's home-cooked meals are varied and filling, and she herself is warm and refreshingly direct.

items.name: Yusuf A.
items.text: A really lovely campsite. 15 minutes to the market, 10 minutes to the beach on foot. Hala took great care of us - we had a wonderful 3 days.

items.name: Gülsen Ç.
items.text: The entrance to the camp is modest and calm, the right place if you want to clear your head. I felt right at home. Hala doesn't see guests as customers - human values come first here. I'll definitely be back.

items.name: Eylem
items.text: We spent two lovely days under the orange trees. Hala's warmth and hospitality made us feel right at home. Thank you for the great home-cooked meals and care.

items.name: Bengi Gökçe C.
items.text: The campsite among the orange and lemon trees was really beautiful. We spent most of our time on the daybeds chatting with Hala. Breakfast and dinner were filling and delicious, and showers/toilets were no problem at all.

items.question: How far in advance should I make a reservation?
items.answer: During peak season (June-September), we recommend contacting us at least 3-4 days in advance; for other periods, 1-2 days is enough. Please reach out via WhatsApp.

items.question: Do I need to bring my own tent?
items.answer: Yes, you'll need to bring your own tent. We provide wooden platforms for setting it up.

items.question: How is pricing calculated?
items.answer: Pricing is per person, per night. Discounts are available for children. Contact us via WhatsApp for current rates.

items.question: Are pets allowed?
items.answer: Leashed and well-behaved pets are welcome. Just let us know when making your reservation.

items.question: Is parking free?
items.answer: Yes, both on-site and roadside parking are completely free.

items.question: Is electricity and charging available?
items.answer: Yes, an electricity connection is available.

items.question: How do I get to Olympos?
items.answer: There are regular minibuses from Kumluca or Finike. By car, it's about 1.5 hours from Antalya.

items.question: Is there a quiet hours policy?
items.answer: We have a quiet hours policy after 23:00. We kindly ask all guests to respect it for a peaceful camping experience.
